title: MT61144: Advanced Mechanical Working Of Materials
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction to metal working processes; Continuum plasticity: plastic stressstrain relations, plastic anisotropy, upper bound forces, slip line field
theory, deformation zone geometry; Material Properties and characteristics
under processing: Flow instability, drawability; Mechanics of metal working:
calculation of load, power and energy, friction and lubrication. Selected metal
working processes like Forging, Rolling, Extrusion, Drawing and Sheet metal
Forming: classification of processes, design of specific metal working
processes e.g roll-pass design, estimation of load, force, power etc for these
processes with various deformation geometry and operation variables;
Metallurgical factors in metal working and thermo-mechanical processing;
Modelling and simulation of specific working processes; Nonconventional
processes: Superplastic forming, high energy rate forming etc.
